enfantsNous.modesDesc: The 12 questions are the same either way. Together, each of you answers separately and the quiz looks for the family that best matches your answers.
enfantsNous.modeDuoDesc: You each answer the 12 questions on the same phone, without seeing the other's answers.
enfantsNous.modeDuoMeta: Your result as a couple and your differences
enfantsNous.modeSolo: On my own, for our couple
enfantsNous.modeSoloDesc: You answer with your couple in mind.
enfantsNous.setupTitreDuo: How many kids will you have?
enfantsNous.setupDescDuo: Enter your first names. The first person answers the 12 questions and then hands the phone over. At the end you'll see your result as a couple and the questions where you didn't give the same answer.
enfantsNous.setupTitreSolo: How many kids will you have?
enfantsNous.setupDescSolo: The quiz asks 12 questions about the life you picture, for example your Sundays or your holidays. Answer with your relationship in mind.
enfantsNous.relaisDebut: Answer the 12 questions, then pass the phone.
enfantsNous.relaisSuite: {{nom}} is done. Your turn, no peeking at their answers!
enfantsNous.chacunMeme: On your own, you'd each have got the same result. You picture the same family!
enfantsNous.chacunGagne: Your result as a couple is {{nom}}'s. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
enfantsNous.chacunCompromis: Your result as a couple isn't either of your own results. It's the one with the most points when your answers are added up.
enfantsNous.memesReponsesUne: Just one identical answer out of {{total}}.
enfantsNous.accordHaut: You picture more or less the same family life.
enfantsNous.accordMoyen: You agree on the main things but there are two or three points left to talk about.
enfantsNous.accordBas: You don't picture the same family life at all. It's an important subject, so take the time to talk about it.
enfantsNous.ecartsTitre: Where you didn't give the same answer
enfantsNous.jaugesTitre: The results closest to your answers
enfantsNous.invitationDuo: And what family does your partner picture? Take the quiz again together to compare your answers.
enfantsNous.noteFin: This quiz is a game. It doesn't predict the future and it knows nothing about your health or your situation. The photos were created for this page.
enfantsNous.p_zero_d: Your answers describe a life without children. You value your freedom, your travels and your lie-ins. Plenty of couples make this choice and they don't have to justify it.
enfantsNous.p_zero_a: If one of you changes your mind one day, just say so. It's a subject you're allowed to come back to.
enfantsNous.p_un_d: Your answers describe a family of three. You'd like a child and you also want to keep time for your relationship and your plans. With one child, you can take them almost everywhere with you.
enfantsNous.p_un_a: People will often ask you when the second one is coming. You're allowed to answer that your family is complete.
enfantsNous.p_deux_d: Your answers describe a family of four. You picture a lively home but not an overwhelmed one. You can see yourselves with two children who play together and squabble now and then.
enfantsNous.p_deux_a: Two children means twice as much organising. Talk about who will do what before the first one arrives.
enfantsNous.p_trois_d: Your answers describe a family of five. Noise doesn't scare you and you love a full table. You're ready to trade a bit of peace for a lot of life at home!
enfantsNous.p_trois_a: With three children you often need a bigger car and sometimes a bigger home. Have a look at your budget before you start.
enfantsNous.p_tribu_d: Your answers describe a big family. You dream of a full house, with bunk beds and cousins everywhere in the holidays. For you, the more the merrier!
enfantsNous.p_tribu_a: A big family takes a lot of energy. Keep some time for your relationship, even just one evening a month.
enfantsNous.p_plustard_d: Your answers say now isn't the time. You have other plans to see through first, for example a trip or a change of job. You're not saying no to a child but you're in no hurry.
enfantsNous.p_plustard_a: Bring it up again from time to time. Check that “later” means the same thing to each of you.
